info.title: Global Probabilistic Weather Forecasting Platform API

get.description: Retrieve all supported meteorological forecast centers.
Retrieve supported operational and AI weather models.

Retrieve ingested model execution cycles and their statuses.

A run's ``model_id`` is resolved through the schema's existing
``model_versions`` relationship (a run is keyed by model version, not by
model directly).

Return the available model/variable/initial-time/lead-time structure.

The response is generated from the database on every request, so newly
ingested runs (new models, variables, initial times, or lead times)
become visible automatically without any code or configuration change.

Search cities, ski resorts, stations, or places.

The ``q`` parameter is required. ``type`` restricts the search to one
platform location table (``city``, ``resort``, or ``station``), searches
all of them (``all``, the default), or delegates to the place-autocomplete
provider (``place``). Results are returned in the universal list envelope.

get.description:
Resolve a selected place suggestion to its canonical location.

The user selects an autocomplete suggestion (which carries a ``place_id``
but no coordinates yet); this endpoint resolves the canonical display
name, latitude/longitude, country, and region so the map recenters and the
point forecast updates.

Return hourly forecasts for a resolved geographic location.

Exactly one spatial specifier is required: a ``lat``/``lon`` pair, a
``city_id``, or a ``resort_id``. ``models`` accepts exactly one model
identifier; multi-model requests are rejected with 422 (see the module
docstring).

get.description:
Return connectivity status for database, Redis, and object storage.

The probe result is deterministic per request: each dependency is probed
live and reported as ``connected`` or ``disconnected``. The overall
``status`` is ``healthy`` when every dependency is connected and
``degraded`` otherwise (with an HTTP ``503`` status).

EnsembleStatisticsEnvelope.title: EnsembleStatisticsEnvelope
EnsembleStatisticsEnvelope.description: The ensemble statistics response envelope (API.md sections 5.1 and 2.3).

ForecastAvailabilityData.title: ForecastAvailabilityData
ForecastAvailabilityData.description:
The payload of the forecast availability endpoint.

Models are ordered by model id; only models that have at least one
``ready`` run with forecast product rows are included, so the list
reflects exactly what the platform can serve.

ForecastAvailabilityEnvelope.title: ForecastAvailabilityEnvelope
ForecastAvailabilityEnvelope.description:
The forecast availability response envelope.

``object`` is ``forecast_availability`` (a new resource shape that is a
non-breaking addition to the v1 surface per API.md section 1.3).

ForecastLocationOut.title: ForecastLocationOut
ForecastLocationOut.description: The resolved location of a point forecast (API.md section 2.1).

ForecastSeries.title: ForecastSeries
ForecastSeries.description:
A single forecast entry indexed by lead time (API.md section 2.1).

Requested forecast variables are attached as additional top-level keys
(e.g. ``temperature_2m``), matching the dynamic keyed shape shown in
API.md. Variable keys are captured through ``extra="allow"``.

``cycle_time`` is the source forecast run's cycle/reference time. The point
forecast is a **cross-cycle** deterministic time series: entries may come
from different cycles (the minimum-lead record for each valid_time), so the
source cycle is exposed to make the provenance unambiguous. It is additive
and non-breaking.

HealthCheckData.title: HealthCheckData
HealthCheckData.description:
The payload of a system health check (API.md section 8.1).

``status`` is ``healthy`` when every dependency is connected and
``degraded`` otherwise. ``version`` is the API contract version.

HealthCheckEnvelope.title: HealthCheckEnvelope
HealthCheckEnvelope.description: The health check response envelope (API.md sections 8.1 and 2.3).

InitialTimeAvailability.title: InitialTimeAvailability
InitialTimeAvailability.description:
One available forecast initialization (cycle time) of a variable.

Attributes:
    value: The run's ``cycle_time`` in ISO 8601 UTC. ``valid_time`` for a
        given lead is derived as ``value + lead_time_hours``
        (DATABASE.md section 1).
    lead_time_hours: The publicly servable forecast offset hours available
        for this model/variable/initial time (coverage >= 85%), ascending.
    status: The run lifecycle status (e.g. 'ready', 'processing', 'partial').
    leads: Rich lead-level coverage descriptors including below-threshold leads.

valid_time_vector_field_url_template.title: Valid Time Vector Field Url Template

LayerDescriptor.title: LayerDescriptor
LayerDescriptor.description: The spatial layer descriptor for rendering map tiles and legends.

LeadAvailabilityOut.title: LeadAvailabilityOut
LeadAvailabilityOut.description: Rich lead-level availability and member-coverage metadata.

ModelAvailability.title: ModelAvailability
ModelAvailability.description:
A forecast model and the variables available for it.

Attributes:
    id: The ``models.model_id`` (e.g. ``gfs``).
    name: Human-readable model name.
    is_ensemble: Whether the model is an ensemble product.
    variables: The variables with ready forecast data for this model,
        ordered by variable code.

PointForecastData.title: PointForecastData
PointForecastData.description:
The payload of a point forecast (API.md section 2.1).

``generated_at`` is the forecast dataset generation time -- the selected
model run's ``cycle_time`` -- so that identical forecast data produces
identical payloads and deterministic cache behavior.

PointForecastEnvelope.title: PointForecastEnvelope
PointForecastEnvelope.description:
The point forecast response envelope (API.md sections 2.1 and 2.3).

Only the documented single-model ``point_forecast`` envelope is
implemented in Milestone 9. The multi-model response format is not
defined by the approved design documents and is therefore a recorded
specification gap; multi-model requests are rejected (see the
``/v1/points`` router).

ProbabilityForecastEnvelope.title: ProbabilityForecastEnvelope
ProbabilityForecastEnvelope.description: The probability forecast response envelope (API.md sections 3.1 and 2.3).

SearchResultOut.title: SearchResultOut
SearchResultOut.description:
A location search result (API.md section 6.1).

The ``object`` field distinguishes the source table: ``city``,
``ski_resort``, or ``station``. Type-specific fields (``region``,
``country``, ``elevation_m``) are optional because not every source
table defines them.

SpatialLayerData.title: SpatialLayerData
SpatialLayerData.description: The payload of a spatial layer (API.md section 4.1).

SpatialLayerEnvelope.title: SpatialLayerEnvelope
SpatialLayerEnvelope.description: The spatial layer response envelope (API.md sections 4.1 and 2.3).

SpatialLayerLegend.title: SpatialLayerLegend
SpatialLayerLegend.description: The legend of a spatial layer (API.md section 4.1).

ValidTimeAvailabilityOut.title: ValidTimeAvailabilityOut
ValidTimeAvailabilityOut.description:
A valid time available for a model variable under Lifecycle V2.

Attributes:
    valid_time: The UTC valid datetime.
    source_cycle: The newest committed cycle providing this valid time.
    lead_time_hours: The lead offset from source cycle.
    servable: Whether the lead is servable.
    available_members: Number of available ensemble members.
    expected_members: Expected ensemble members for the model.
    coverage_ratio: Member coverage ratio in [0.0, 1.0].

VariableAvailability.title: VariableAvailability
VariableAvailability.description:
A forecast variable and the initial times / valid times available for it.

Attributes:
    id: The ``forecast_variables.variable_code`` (e.g.
        ``temperature_2m``).
    name: Human-readable variable name.
    unit: The registered SI unit string (e.g. ``°C``).
    initial_times: The initial times with data for this
        model/variable, newest first (legacy compatibility).
    valid_times: The unified, cross-cycle valid times available for this
        model/variable under Lifecycle V2, ascending.
    layer: Authoritative map layer descriptor for rendering tiles and
        legends without an extra metadata roundtrip.

VerificationPeriod.title: VerificationPeriod
VerificationPeriod.description:
The verification date window (API.md section 7.1).

``start`` and ``end`` are inclusive calendar dates (the window spans
``[start 00:00:00Z, end + 1 day)``).

VerificationReportData.title: VerificationReportData
VerificationReportData.description:
The payload of a verification report (API.md section 7.1).

``metrics`` maps a flat per-variable key (``{variable}_rmse``,
``{variable}_bias``, ``{variable}_mae``) to its value. A variable with no
valid forecast/observation pairs in the window contributes no keys, so
``metrics`` may be empty.

VerificationReportEnvelope.title: VerificationReportEnvelope
VerificationReportEnvelope.description: The verification report response envelope (API.md sections 7.1 and 2.3).
